outcome: International Ovarian Tumor Analysis simple rules classification
incidence of complications related to the mass
cohort: Pregnant women with an adnexal mass detected at or prior to their 12-week routine ultrasound.
finding: Adnexal masses in pregnancy are uncommon, with the majority spontaneously resolving, and malignancy and complications being rare.
mod_finding: Intervention for adnexal masses occurred in 6 cases at the time of caesarean section.
